#[cfg(test)]
mod independent_adversary {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    #[test]
    fn literal_tokens_and_fresh_state() {
        let normalizer = Normalizer::new().unwrap();
        let cases: Vec<Value> = serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../cases.json")).unwrap();
        for (index, case) in cases.iter().enumerate() {
            let actual = normalizer.normalize(
                case["branch"].as_str().unwrap(),
                case["input"].as_str().unwrap(),
            );
            match actual {
                Ok(value) => assert_eq!(case.get("value"), Some(&value), "case {index}: {case}"),
                Err(error) => assert_eq!(
                    case.get("errors"),
                    Some(&json!(error.0)),
                    "case {index}: {case}"
                ),
            }
            assert_eq!(
                normalizer.normalize("run/~", "[]").unwrap(),
                json!(["", ""])
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(
            normalizer.normalize("record", r#"{"number":-0}"#).unwrap()["number"]
                .as_f64()
                .unwrap()
                .to_bits(),
            1_u64 << 63
        );
        eprintln!("independent native Rust literal vectors: {}", cases.len());
    }

    #[test]
    fn caller_reaches_guard_after_private_metadata_fault_injection() {
        // A generated source integrity fault is injected only in test-owned memory.
        // This does not claim callers can mutate the private map through the API.
        for arity in [None, Some(0), Some(3)] {
            let mut normalizer = Normalizer::new().unwrap();
            let at = "/branches/pick~1~0/0/value";
            if let Some(arity) = arity {
                normalizer.position_arities.insert(at.to_owned(), arity);
            } else {
                normalizer.position_arities.remove(at);
            }
            let error = normalizer.normalize("pick/~", r#"["a","b"]"#).unwrap_err();
            assert_eq!(
                json!(error.0),
                json!([{"pointer":at,"rule":"position_value","detail":"position encountered a value outside its checked tuple contract"}])
            );
        }
        let mut normalizer = Normalizer::new().unwrap();
        normalizer.position_arities.clear();
        assert_eq!(
            normalizer.normalize("optional", "{}").unwrap(),
            json!("absent")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn decoded_value_provenance_and_retained_entry_order() {
        let normalizer = Normalizer::new().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            normalizer
                .normalize_value("optional", &json!({}))
                .unwrap_err()
                .0[0]
                .rule,
            "input_positional_provenance"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            normalizer
                .normalize_value("record", &json!({}))
                .unwrap_err()
                .0[0]
                .rule,
            "input_capture_provenance"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            normalizer
                .normalize_base64_json("unknown", "!")
                .unwrap_err()
                .0[0]
                .rule,
            "input_base64"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            normalizer
                .normalize_base64_json("run/~", "W251bGwsImIiLDFlOTk5XQ==")
                .unwrap(),
            json!(["", "b"])
        );
    }
}
